'''2020 TMW Pods Jared Napolitano LS They Have No Idea We're Coming''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jared Napolitano]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jared Napolitano]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|They Have No Idea We're Coming / Until We Win, Or The Chances Are Spent|V9-L-theyhavenoideawerecoming.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open They Have No Idea We're Comi Napoli.txt |Download]]
